title: Bash Guard Decision Output (--json mode, v1)
description: Programmatic output schema for the OPA-backed bash guard. INPUT stays OPA/Rego; THIS schema governs the OUTPUT wrapper consumed by pi extensions, scripts, and other agents. Symmetric: both allow and deny emit this shape. Exit codes map 0=allow, 2=deny (backward-compat with Claude Code hook protocol).

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Bump on breaking change. Consumers MUST validate this before reading other fields.

decision.description: Primary verdict. Maps to exit code: allow→0, deny→2.

action.description: Caller guidance. allow=proceed silently; block=stop with message; prompt_user=ask human (future ask-mode, like pi-control's 5 outcomes); log_only=proceed but record. Today only allow/block are emitted; prompt_user/log_only reserved for v2.

source.description: Where the decision came from. opa=live OPA eval; fail-open=OPA unreachable, defaulted allow (see [OT2]); fail-closed=OPA unreachable, defaulted deny; cached=replay of prior decision for identical input within TTL; opa-unlocked=OPA denied but all blocking rules bypassed via valid unlock keys; fail-open-keyless=OPA unreachable AND unlock keys present (degradation, not legitimate bypass); unlock-filter-error=unlock filter crashed, fell back to engine verdict.

reasons.description: Every fired deny rule contributes one entry. Empty array on allow. NOT collapsed to a single string — preserves rule provenance for audit. Order = rule evaluation order (deterministic).

input.description: Echo of the normalized command the parser produced (the decide-half input). Lets consumer verify what was actually evaluated vs what they sent.

summary.description: Human-readable one-liner for TUI/logging. e.g. 'BLOCKED: git stash pop (rule: block-git-stash-mutations)'. Optional on allow (may be empty string).

suggestions.description: Safe alternatives the user could run instead. e.g. ['git stash list', 'git stash show']. Empty array if none. Powering future 'did you mean?' UX.

metadata.description: Provenance for audit: which rulebook, which OPA version, which policy digest decided this. Enables after-the-fact replay and drift detection.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of decision. Millisecond precision.

decision_id.description: Unique ID per decision. Carry through to audit log, hook response, user-facing message — enables end-to-end tracing.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time from input received to decision emitted. For perf monitoring / OPA cold-start detection (relevant to lazy-load topology [LD2]).

signals.description: Collected runtime signals (provenance): git.*, repo.*, worktree.*, env.*. Absent when no signals collected (non-git commands). Each value is the raw signal collector output.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier. Matches the cc-safety-net rule `name` field (e.g. 'block-git-stash-mutations') OR a synthesized ID for built-in semantic rules (e.g. 'builtin:git-stash-drop'). Lets audits trace decision→rule→source line.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Same text as the rule's `reason` field. NOT redacted of secrets here — redaction happens at display layer.

family.description: Rule family for grouping/filtering. Matches the 6 families in the rego translation (turn6).

severity.description: Reserved for v2 tiered outcomes. Today always 'block'. Lets future prompt_user/log_only rules coexist with hard blocks.

bypassed.description: True when this deny reason was bypassed by a valid unlock key.

unlock_key_id.description: First 8 hex of the unlock key mac (truncated — full key MUST NEVER appear).

unlock_key_type.description: Type of unlock key used to bypass this reason.

unlock_status.description: Status of the unlock key attempt for this reason.

raw.description: Original command string as received. May be redacted of secrets at display layer but stored verbatim in JSON for audit (consumer is trusted).

program.description: Normalized program name (lowercase). Empty string if parser could not extract.

subcommand.description: Normalized subcommand. Empty string if none (the bare-default case [OT3] — `git stash` with no sub).

args.description: Normalized arg tokens. Empty array if none.

parse_confidence.description: Parser fidelity. full=bash-parser AST; partial=AST with gaps; regex-only=string match fallback ([OT1] common-case path); failed=could not parse, fell back to raw-string matching only.

engine.description: Decision engine identity. Pinned to 'opa' per [LD1].

opa_version.description: OPA binary version string (e.g. '1.18.1'). For reproducibility.

rulebook_digest.description: SHA-256 prefix (12 hex) of the active rego policy bundle. Matches the cc-safety-net rule.lock digest format. Lets audits detect 'decision made under different rules than current'.

policy_path.description: Filesystem path to the .rego bundle evaluated. For debugging 'which policy fired'.

hostname.description: Dev box hostname (per [LD2] — every dev box runs its own OPA). For correlating decisions across the fleet.

session_id.description: Calling agent's session ID if available (pi session, claude session, etc.). Empty string if not provided.

unlock_count.description: Number of deny reasons bypassed by valid unlock keys.

unlock_blocked_count.description: Number of deny reasons still blocking after unlock attempt (all-or-nothing semantics).

unlock_agent.description: Agent identifier that presented the unlock keys.

pi_opa_net_version.description: pi-opa-net package version (e.g. '0.4.0'). Every audit trace carries this for version correlation when debugging decision trails.

dry_run.description: Present and true when PIOPANET_DRY_RUN=1 is set. Indicates the CLI is in evaluation-only mode (no command execution). Tests and CI should set this flag.

reasons.message: Do not mutate stashes in shared work. Others may be relying on them.
Bare `git stash` defaults to push. Use `git stash list/show` explicitly.
